description: Bounded public disposition for the 2026-09-18 Qwen3.8 Flash-Next deployment measurements: coherent end-to-end generation, deployment canaries, sustained 128-token completions, a 262144-token Q8 KV context pass, a matched control/prefetch pair, the route distribution, and the V2 hot-region experiment. Sanitized values are published; model weights, the scaffold container, the research runtime branch, and raw receipts are excluded.
model_name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next (public model card); deployed bank is a Q2_0 donor scaffold
model_revision: public model card revision; deployed scaffold build excluded from publication
model_download_source: public model card exists but the quantized scaffold container and the deployed bank are not part of this repository
quant_name: Q2_0 donor scaffold (temporary control) with a BF16-derived q4_K/q4_K/q4_0 hot region for the hottest 42% of expert units
quant_format_version: deployed scaffold codec and BF16-derived hot-bank codecs as recorded in the sanitized receipt
hardware_phenotype: reference RX 9060 XT 16 GB (RDNA4 / gfx1200, RADV), 32 GB host RAM, NVMe; phenotype recorded in HARDWARE_PROFILE.md
mesa: reference Mesa/RADV stack recorded in HARDWARE_PROFILE.md
vulkan: the runtime reported a cooperative-matrix capable device; exact loader version recorded in HARDWARE_PROFILE.md
rust: not applicable; these runs used the excluded research runtime branch
compiler: not applicable; the executing branch is excluded from publication
gpu_configuration: reference board configuration as recorded in HARDWARE_PROFILE.md
prompt: a 12-prompt deployment canary set, a two-prompt long-form set (one explanation prompt and one code prompt), a single factual prompt at 262144 context, and a 12-prompt harder panel for corroboration
context_size: 2048 for the deployment runs; 262144 for the context pass
kv_format: q8_0 key and value cache for the context pass; default format otherwise
warmup: process start plus model load; counters sampled every 10 s from process start
raw_output_digest: raw outputs excluded; sanitized values and provenance labels are recorded in sanitized_receipt.json

tolerance.canary_verdict: evaluated against expected answers; no automated grader
tolerance.timing: single matched pair on the reference machine; machine-wide device counters; no counter-balanced repeat

known_limitations: The canary verdict is a judgement over printed outputs; no automated answer grader exists in the harness.
The 262144-token context pass is a capacity and coherence smoke, not a long-context quality result; a 384K profile was defined but never run.
The control/prefetch pair is a single matched pair executed back-to-back; device counters are machine-wide and prefetch emission counters were not logged.
The V2 hot region is a migration configuration: the cold 58% of the population and the non-expert core remain on the temporary Q2 scaffold.
No BF16 capability retention, benchmark retention, or final-V2 quality result is claimed.
Model weights, the scaffold container, the executing research runtime branch, and raw receipts are excluded from publication, so this lane is not a runnable public benchmark.
